reasons: Both answers open by correcting the premise (8 years are not wiped out; cumulative versus continuous years). Both give the 3-month meaning, the 第三个自然月 waiting period (January 2027), the 10-year and 20-year retirement thresholds with the 2-year and 12-year gaps, and 473.67 x 7, about 3,316 yuan, with the 12月31日 deadline and no reimbursement for the supplemented months. A is clearly more complete on the later key points. It gives the 户籍/居住证 eligibility rule and notes the employer cannot back-pay April to October. It gives the 743.60 and 443.75 yuan retirement top-up figures and gives the exact 3,315.69. It also handles the assumption that the 8 years were all in Hangzhou, and says to confirm with the 经办 office. B is tighter but only gestures at eligibility, at the cost of not paying later (no top-up figures), and at the employer limit. A's cost is some padding (the 买房/摇号 tip) and one slip about extra 大病保险 cash. B's lead in concision does not outweigh A's coverage.
